title: Require visible summaries at core research stages
description: Keeps internal tool activity in the process view while requiring concise, user-visible conclusions and progress summaries at core research stages, including full-auto runs.
changes: Separate autonomous execution from silent execution: full-auto skips confirmation waits but still reports completed core stages.
Require concise chat summaries after literature mapping, hypothesis selection, experiment design, asynchronous submission, experiment completion, and final delivery.
Keep fine-grained retrieval, file operations, and formatting activity in the process view.
Treat the inline stage summary as part of stage completion and prevent crossing two core stages without visible assistant text.

rollback.notes: Restore the prior Agent-first venue-aware writing prompt snapshot.
